item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 11/Apr/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The weather will be hot and the visibility will be relatively low over Guangdong in the next couple of days. Under the influence of the northeast monsoon, it will be windier and temperatures will be lower during the day over the coast of southern China in the middle and latter parts of this week. A replenishment of the monsoon is expected to affect the coastal areas of Guangdong and bring relatively cool weather to the region early next week. Tropical Cyclone Megi will lingering over the eastern part of the Philippines and weaken gradually in the next couple of days. Tropical Cyclone Malakas will move across the western North Pacific today. It will then move north and affect the seas south of Japan.
